scenario_description:
Objective: Notice a short chance to add a low-crowd pilot-house mini-tour to an already planned harbor open-house outing.
Emerging Need: The add-on is optional and only useful after Mateo confirms he still wants the outing, a cancellation slot appears, and the saved preference authorizes low-commitment coordination.
Decision Context: The calendar, desk contact, Mateo’s message, and open-house notices together define who could use the slot, how it can be held, and when that window expires.
Consequence: Timely coordination could add a pleasant maritime-interest extra; doing nothing leaves the original open-house visit unchanged once the cancellation is released.

parameter.title: Harbor open house with Mateo
parameter.description: General exhibit visit; optional demonstrations are first-come and require same-day desk holds.

parameter.name: Nauticus Open House Desk
parameter.notes: Same-day holds for low-crowd pilot-house mini-tours are handled by email; phone line is informational only during open-house check-in.

parameter.content: Still good for the open house today. I’m taking the 14:05 bus and will keep texts on until I leave.

parameter.subject: One quiet pilot-house mini-tour spot opened for today
parameter.body: A cancellation has opened one no-cost attendee spot plus one no-cost companion space on the 15:30 low-crowd pilot-house mini-tour for registered open-house guests. The desk can hold it under an attendee name until 13:40 today; after that the spot returns to the walk-up manifest.

parameter.subject: Pilot-house cancellation spot released
parameter.body: The 15:30 low-crowd pilot-house cancellation spot has been assigned to a waiting walk-up guest and companion. The afternoon mini-tour list is full, with no remaining space for this departure.
